code_summary: Four dataset-specific ensembles combine unchanged residual MultVAE and SASRec through equal-weight candidate-rank fusion. SASRec adds a 32-dimensional first-order transition dot product using separate source and destination embeddings. Zero-initialized destination factors make its initial contribution exactly zero; padded sources are masked. Training uses current sequence items as sources, while inference uses the last item. Checkpoint configs and the predictor writer reconstruct the transition architecture with strict loading. Code includes transition, checkpoint-reload, and exported-predictor checks, but the supplied output does not establish which checks completed.
